_note: PLACEHOLDER items, texts and numbers written by Claude so the bag and shop can be tried. Owner D: replace them and delete this line. kind is consumable or equipment. Equipment needs a slot: weapon, head, body, legs, shoes or accessory (there are two accessory slots). A weapon has a weight: heavy (more damage, minus answer seconds), light (plus answer seconds, a bit less damage) or normal (no time change). A weapon may have attack: bow or staff; that only changes how its attack LOOKS (an arrow or a bolt flies to the enemy instead of a swing). Equipment has no effect yet: that rule is for D and B to write. effect is read by systems/item_effects.py. Rarities from docs/HANDOFF.md: common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary.
_stack_note: How many of one item fit in ONE bag slot, by kind (like Minecraft stacks). 10 potions share a slot; the 11th starts a new slot. Equipment never stacks.
